purpose: Teach: ウロウロ/かっこよく/光り/営む/釣る/働ける/チョン/リョウ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お庭を、絶対、ウロウロ、絶対、しちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I really did wander around in the garden.
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact confession. Rushed delivery on the repetitions, like he's getting the admission out before he loses nerve. Quiet at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しいお洋服、絶対、かっこよく、絶対、似合うわよ
lines.en: Sho, those new clothes look really sharp on you, you know.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring tone. Gentle lift on the praise — not overplaying it, just genuine approval. The cadence of a mother noticing something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お星様の、絶対、光り、絶対、輝いて、絶対、綺麗だね
lines.en: Mom, the starlight is so beautiful and bright, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft wonder. Slow, careful pace — he's really looking at it. Trace of awe in his voice. Trailing off gently, like he's sharing a small discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、長年、絶対、商売を、絶対、営む、絶対、人だったのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather was a man who ran his business for many, many years.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. A small pause before she speaks, gathering the memory. Tender weight on the words — she's sharing something that matters about his lineage.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、川で、絶対、お魚、絶対、釣る、絶対、約束、絶対、したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I made a promise to go fishing in the river.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick pace — he's excited about it. A little breathless on the details, wanting to make sure she knows he's serious about this promise.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、大きくなって、絶対、働ける、絶対、ようになったら、絶対、嬉しいわよ
lines.en: Sho, when you grow up and can work, that'll make me so happy.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful. Slow and deliberate — this isn't small talk. Warm affection underneath, with a hint of quiet hope about his future.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、絵本で、絶対、チョン、絶対、髷、絶対、お侍さん、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw a samurai with a chonmage topknot in a picture book.
lines.style: Animated, bright curiosity. Quick tempo on the discoveries. A small laugh quality in his voice — he's delighted by the strange, old-fashioned hairstyle.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんの友達、本気で、絶対、リョウ、絶対、子さんって、絶対、いう方なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, my friend Ryouko is a wonderful person, you know.
lines.style: Warm, conversational intimacy. Relaxed pace. A small smile in the voice — the affection you have for someone you've known a long time and chosen to keep close.
